title: Word Formation: Przeczenia: im-, ir- i il- (krok 2: przedrostki)

tasks.instruction: Uzupelnij kazde zdanie jednym wyrazem, przeksztalcajac wyraz podany wielkimi literami obok luki. Kazde zdanie potrzebuje przedrostka, ktory odwraca znaczenie wyrazu. Wymagana jest calkowita poprawnosc ortograficzna.

items.sentence: It is __________ to breathe underwater without equipment.
Don't be so __________ - the bus will come eventually.
His heartbeat was __________, so they sent him for tests.
Leaving a fire burning in a forest is deeply __________.
Parking in front of the hospital entrance is __________.
Your argument is __________ - those two facts cannot both be true.
It is __________ to interrupt someone in the middle of a sentence.
The judge said the evidence was __________ to this case.
